description: Take the pressure off mealtime! The Blue Diamond Weekday Wonder One Touch 16-in-1 Pressure Cooker/Slow Cooker is the no-pressure cooking solution! Make a whole meal with the touch of a button. Our easy to use presets are designed to make everything easy. But that’s not all! We’ve reengineered our signature pan's nonstick coating for optimal performance under pressure. Other nonstick pan and pressure cooker coatings break down from the intense strain of use, but our exclusive nonstick coating is made to take the tension over and over while still delivering easy to clean results. The smart release function automatically customizes pressure to maximize flavors and the quick release function safely releases pressure in an instant from the control panel. No knobs or levers necessary! The Weekday Wonder has 16 easy functions for incredible ways to cook: Quick Release, Delay Start, Smart Release, Slow Cook, Soup/Broth, Bean/Chili, Meat/Stew, Poultry, Multigrains, Oatmeal, Yogurt, Sterilize, Sauté, Steam, Cake, and Rice! The removable pot is dishwasher safe and our best nonstick yet. The Weekday Wonder Includes: easy recipes, a stainless steel steamer rack, a measuring cup, and a spatula.
